holt_winters.init: two first seasons (trend, level, centred indices)

candidates.interval: nearest-rank 10/90 of DT-056 on in-sample errors per horizon (fitted parameters)
candidates.label: PROPUESTA (provisional)
candidates.selection: minimum one-step SSE inside the training window; ties → first (smallest) grid combination

criteria.bias: absolute relative bias at L+R ≤ 0.1; segments ≥ 10 products not worse than 0.05
criteria.coverage: nominal 0.8; calibrated if within [0.75, 0.85] per horizon on the late cuts (label of the band only)
criteria.cuts: aggregate and ≥ ⌈2/3⌉ of the comparable cuts, minimum 5; fewer → not conclusive
criteria.level2: units short ≤ +2%, fill rate ≥ −0.002, average inventory ≤ +5%
criteria.primary: MASE at LR; h = 1 secondary (DT-093 point 1)
criteria.segments: no segment with ≥ 10 products worse than 5%

dt011.exclude: observed days × 7 / days_observed; weeks without observed days omitted
dt011.extreme: series with more than 50% stockout days reported apart
dt011.impute: mean of the non-stockout days of the previous 56 days; none → as is
dt011.models: official baseline, SES and the 2 best candidates by Level 1 (lowest MASE at L+R relative to the official baseline on their pairwise comparable set)

simulator.baselines_and_ses: as in F5b (forecast recomputed at every decision)
simulator.substitution: official baseline points when the candidate is not eligible or invalid; counted

us055.calibration: per model and horizon, factor k of the grid that brings the coverage of [p − k(p − lower), p + k(upper − p)] (lower ≥ 0) closest to the nominal level on the cuts whose evaluation ends on or before the measured cut; ties → smaller k

ses.interval: nearest-rank 10/90 of DT-056 on SES errors per horizon (fixed alpha)
ses.selection: minimum one-step SSE inside the training window; ties → smallest alpha

simulation.label: PROPUESTA (provisional) where marked
simulation.lead_time_observations: real lines issued up to the first cut; U1 keeps those completed by each decision

open_lines_rule.status: DT-080 point 7 by default; ACTUAL_RECEIPTS pending the responsable (OD-S1)

simulation.population: validity on the first cut (DT-087) and an active preferred supplier (L + R)
